summary: The AI Study Assistant project has several high-priority tasks approaching due dates with some blocked tasks impacting critical path progress. Budget status is healthy but risk factors from integration delays and blockers must be addressed to ensure release readiness.

attention_items.reason: High priority task blocked and due soon, delaying dependent tasks and potentially the final release milestone.
attention_items.impact: Delays on security-critical features can cascade, affecting integration and release schedules.
attention_items.recommended_action: Prioritize resolving the blocking issues preventing progress on authentication and access control.

attention_items.title: End-to-End Integration Testing is Blocked
attention_items.reason: Critical final testing blocked, jeopardizing the confirmed release readiness milestone M6.

attention_items.recommended_action: Address blockers and enable testing team to proceed with end-to-end tests immediately.

attention_items.title: Multiple High-Priority Tasks Approaching Deadlines
attention_items.reason: Build Student Dashboard, Implement Knowledge Agent, Orchestrator Routing, and Agent Communication have imminent due dates within the next few days.
attention_items.impact: Missing deadlines on these critical path tasks may delay downstream integration and release milestones.
attention_items.recommended_action: Monitor and support these teams to ensure on-time completion and escalate risks early.

attention_items.title: Risk of Integration Delays
attention_items.reason: Risk register cites integration delays, which aligns with current blocked tasks and dependencies in project plan.
attention_items.impact: Delays in integration could jeopardize final milestones and overall release readiness.
attention_items.recommended_action: Implement mitigation plans from risk register, increase communication across teams focused on integration.

Support high-priority tasks with approaching deadlines to avoid cascading delays.
Monitor integration risks actively and enforce mitigation plans from risk register.
